name: gestao-financeira
description: Sistema de Gestão Financeira, Projetos e Custos

scripts.deploy:site: cd api && npx wrangler pages deploy ../site --project-name=saldao
scripts.deploy:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../api && npx wrangler pages deploy ../frontend/dist --project-name=gestao
scripts.deploy:api: cd api && npm install && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:frontend && npm run deploy:api
